scenarios.prompt: Resolve a versioned ranged request with stable shot identity, source/filter state and ordered impact events while tracers and other presentation remain non-authoritative.

criteria.identity: Shot/projectile IDs, fire-confirm time and collision/filter revision are explicit.
criteria.ownership: Aim/handling supplies intent, collision supplies filtering, and this skill owns ranged impact resolution.
criteria.evidence: The same authoritative request produces the same canonical ordered impacts and one shot cannot double-commit an impact.
